_about: Sal, 2026-10-31; read by the server (server_items.gd _goals_data) and shown in the Journal. Starter goals for the first island, taken from TUTORIAL_FIRST_30_MIN.md (the guide's text is the source of truth for hint wording). Format for a coder: `goals` is an ordered list; each goal has `id`, `title`, `hint` (plain text shown in the goal list), `after` (goal ids that must be done first; empty = available at start), `check` (one of: {event, count, what?} fired by the server when the thing happens, {have_item, count} true while the pack holds that many, {made_item, count} counted when a craft finishes, {got_item, count} counted when the player gathers it first-hand (not trades, rewards, refunds or admin gives), {have_item_any, count}), and `stage` (the progression stage; the goal pays that stage's copper from data/items/goal_rewards.json, coins only). A goal completes once and is saved per character (characters.json `goals_done`). Events to emit in server_items.gd: drink, tree_felled, fire_lit, ate_food, placed(what), carcass_worked.

goals.title: Drink at the water
goals.hint: Walk to the water's edge and press E to drink.

goals.title: Gather plant fibre
goals.hint: Nettles and tall grass give plant fibre. Press E on a plant.

goals.title: Twist twine
goals.hint: Open the inventory (I), pick Twine and craft it: 3 plant fibre make 1 twine.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Axe
goals.hint: 1 stone, 1 stick and 2 twine make a Stone - Axe. Put it on the hotbar to use it.

goals.title: Fell a tree
goals.hint: Hold the axe and strike a tree again and again. It breaks into logs, sticks and leaves when it lands.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Hammer
goals.hint: Make a Stone - Hammer from a stone, a stick and a twine. You build and repair with it, and it breaks stone and ore from boulders.

goals.title: Light a fire
goals.hint: Make a Campfire (6 sticks, 16 stones) and place it. Put sticks on it with F, then press E near it to light it.

goals.title: Make the wooden tools
goals.hint: Craft both in the inventory (I), keeping a stone in your pack: a Wooden - Hoe (2 sticks, 1 twine) treads paths and breaks ground for beds, and a Wooden - Shovel (2 sticks) digs clay, sand and bog iron.

goals.title: Tread a path from camp to the water
goals.hint: Hold the hoe and left click along the ground from your fire towards the water. Or Shift + right click to drop survey markers as you walk and the road builds itself. Paths are faster to walk.

goals.title: Eat something wild
goals.hint: Pick berries or fruit with E and eat them. Put raw meat in the fire with F; cook plants in a pot.

goals.title: Build a lean-to
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Lean-to: 20 sticks, 60 leaves and 6 twine. Build it with the open side towards you.

goals.title: Make a bed
goals.hint: Make a bed and place it in your lean-to: a Thatch - Bed from your pack (10 thatch from thatch grass or heather, 4 sticks, 2 twine), or a Straw - Bed with the hammer. Any bed counts.

goals.title: Build a Workbench
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Wooden - Workbench: 16 sticks, 6 twine and 8 stones. At it you make cobblestones, stone blocks, wooden pins, the flint scraper and more.

goals.title: Make a spear
goals.hint: A Wooden - Spear (1 stick, keep a stone) then 2 twine and a stone for a Stone - Spear.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Knife
goals.hint: Open the inventory (I) and craft a Stone - Knife: 2 stones and a stick. You carve, skin and cut with it.

goals.title: Make every stone tool
goals.hint: Craft the rest of the stone set in the inventory (I): a Stone - Pickaxe (3 stones, 2 sticks, 2 twine) breaks boulders and takes copper, tin and coal, and a Stone - Saw (2 stones, 1 stick, 1 twine) cuts logs into boards by hand. With your Stone - Axe, Stone - Hammer and Stone - Knife that is all five.

goals.title: Make a Fishing spear
goals.hint: With your knife in your pack, craft a Fishing spear from a stick (the knife is kept). It spears fish in shallow water.

goals.title: Catch a fish
goals.hint: Hold the Fishing spear, stand still (not swimming) within reach of water between ankle and waist deep, and jab it in. Later a fishing rod (2 sticks, 2 twine and a hook carved from a bone) or a fishing net (3 rope, 4 stones) catches more.

goals.title: Hunt an animal and work the body
goals.hint: Strike an animal with your spear (a rabbit is the easiest), then hold your knife and work the body: meat, hide and bone. You need them for jerky, warm clothes and a fishing hook; bigger animals such as deer, boar and badger also give fat for candles.

goals.title: Snare small game
goals.hint: Make a Snare (3 twine and 2 sticks) and set it on a rabbit run: a thin line of matted grass leading out from a warren. Rabbits come out along their runs from dusk to dawn, so set it in the evening and look in the morning. Work the catch with a knife.

goals.title: Sell to Hob
goals.hint: Hob the trader buys what you pick. Talk to him with E, ask what he sells, and sell him a lot of stones.

goals.title: Fill Hob's order
goals.hint: Ask Hob: Any order for today? Pick what he wants and bring it back. He pays once a day.
